files.name: motion-prompt-079.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Scroll progress bar" (スクロールプログレスバー), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #079

What it is: A bar at the top shows how far you have read
What the sample shows: As the article is read a bit at a time, the line along the top grows from the left and reaches the far end at the bottom of the page.
Spec:
- The article scrolls 0→430 px in four 110 px steps, each moving for 0.45 s then pausing 0.4 s (cubic ease-in-out).
- It returns 430→0 at 3.75–4.55 s.
- A 6 px bar along the top of the viewport: light grey track, orange fill.
- Fill width = 511 px × scroll / 430, the scroll fraction itself (the same as CSS animation-timeline: scroll()).
When to use it: Use it on long articles to show how much is left to read.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/079.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
